messages:
Incidents Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Auth provider (Okta) signature verification errors observed across eu-west and us-east for token-introspect endpoints. 45% of login attempts failing. Paging sam (oncall).

sam (oncall): on it, pinging maria. any confirm from monitoring?
maria (sre): Grafana shows spike in /introspect 5xx and signature-verification failures in the auth-proxy logs. Rolling count of failed signature checks ~47% over 3m.
kevin (platform): seeing related SLO errors for console login. Customer sessions failing on UI; API token flows partially degraded.
elaine (support): already getting a couple of customer reports: "can't log into dashboard" — emailing affected customers. Need ETA.
chris (eng): pulling logs now. stack shows jwks fetch returned 200 but 'kid' mismatch and signature decode errors. suspect new key rotation on provider side not yet synced to our cache.
maria (sre): can we confirm jwks cache TTL and propagation?
chris (eng): config is TTL=5m, but our async fetch worker appears to have backpressure (obs vendor ingestion delayed). We have stale keys for some shards.
sam (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) increase jwks refresh frequency to immediate for affected regions, 2) enable local cached-jwks fallback (allow verification against last-known keys), 3) open a rate-limited bypass for console auth to use session-cookie validation if introspect fails. Approve?
kevin (platform): +1 on refresh and cached fallback. Bypass is riskier but acceptable for console only with strict audit logging. Need rollout steps.
chris (eng): implementing hot reload for jwks: patching auth-proxy to fetch on 429/5xx and on kid-mismatch. Deploying patch to eu-west canary now.
maria (sre): I'll kick failover policy: route introspect to backup auth endpoint in us-central for new requests while we heal eu-west.
Incidents Bot: PagerDuty: sam acknowledged the incident.
statusbot: Posted preliminary status page: "Partial login failures for EU/US regions. Investigating."

chris (eng): canary looks good in eu-west after forced fetch. signature-verif failures dropped to 2%. Rolling to remainder of fleet.
maria (sre): rolling config to increase jwks refresh to 30s and enable aggressive backfill for missing kids. Pushing in 2 minutes.
elaine (support): updating customers: QA message drafted — will send to affected tenants flagged by region.
sam (oncall): monitor for user impact after roll. Maria, what's the expected time to fully converge?
maria (sre): with aggressive fetch and backfill, keys should sync within ~3-5 minutes cluster-wide. We'll keep the backup route for 15m.
chris (eng): added temporary log flag to capture raw 'kid' and jwks fetch response for forensic offline. Also added alert for repeated kid-mismatch per app.
kevin (platform): we're enabling console-only fallback: if introspect fails with sigverif and cookie session exists, allow read-only console access and require reauth on critical actions. Auditing enabled. Pushing policy now.
elaine (support): sent targeted emails to 12 tenants, posted update to status page. Some customers replied about tokens failing for API integrations (not console).
sam (oncall): API token flows should follow the same jwks fallback. If persistent failures, we'll route to backup provider via proxy. Maria, what's our threshold to flip to backup provider?
maria (sre): if >10% failure after 20m of mitigation, we start proxying introspect to backup provider. We'll wait 15m and reassess.
Incidents Bot: Automated note: incident channel created, severity P1.
chris (eng): logs show Okta rotated a key without publishing kid mapping on edge infra for a subset of certs — looks like partial propagation from their CDN. We opened support case with provider (ticket #OK-83421) and pasted traces.
kevin (platform): good to know cause. Are there any downstream observability gaps? Our Sentry shows rate limits on their ingestion around same timeframe.
maria (sre): yes, Sentry ingest spikes caused delayed worker responsiveness which slowed jwks refresh. We're treating this as cascading third-party dependency issue (auth provider + obs vendor).
kevin (platform): adding runbook action: decouple critical jwks fetch path from non-blocking observability worker — making fetch synchronous for next 10m to ensure keys update.
chris (eng): applied synchronous fetch patch on prod edge. Confirmed immediate 200/valid jwks in responses.
elaine (support): customers on threads are seeing logins return. drafting post-mortem note and timeline.
sam (oncall): patch looks stable. signature verification failures down to 0.8% in last 2m. Holding monitor for 20m.
statusbot: Status update posted: "Mitigation in place — jwks refresh and cached fallback applied; investigating root cause with vendor. Partial impact reduced."
chris (eng): next steps: 1) revert console-only bypass after 1h, 2) add stronger kid-mismatch alerting, 3) implement jwks prefetch on key-rotation webhook (if vendor supports), 4) create runbook for cross-vendor cascade scenarios.
maria (sre): I'll create an incident timeline and assign postmortem. Recommend action: increase jwks TTL to shorter with jitter and add backup provider health check.
kevin (platform): will raise SLAs with observability vendor and request guaranteed ingestion capacity for critical fetch paths.
elaine (support): prepping FAQ + customer communication to go out after postmortem.
sam (oncall): thanks all. Leaving channel open for 30m watch, will hand off to morning shift if stable.
Incidents Bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 1999992600.
statusbot: Final update posted: "Service restored for majority of users. Postmortem forthcoming."
chris (eng): recording timeline and artifacts. Please add any missing notes.
elaine (support): adding list of impacted tenants and copy of sent emails to the incident doc.
maria (sre): postmortem created and assigned to chris + sam.
sam (oncall): handing off to morning oncall. Good job team. :thumbsup:
